themes.name: Critical Thinking Enhancement
themes.definition: The use of AI tools to improve students' critical thinking abilities, as observed in various educational interventions where AI integration leads to measurable improvements in critical thinking skills.
evidence: [Elmotri2025] significant improvements in students' writing proficiency, particularly in grammar accuracy, vocabulary enrichment, creativity, and critical thinking.
[Huang2023] prompted greater improvements in the following learning strategies: rehearsal, critical thinking, metacognitive self-regulation, effort regulation, and peer learning.
[Zhao2025] Generative Artificial Intelligence Amplifies the Role of Critical Thinking Skills

themes.name: Integration of Generative AI Technologies
themes.definition: The incorporation of generative artificial intelligence, such as ChatGPT and large language models, into educational settings for teaching, learning, and assessment, as a central component of pedagogical innovation.
evidence: [Elmotri2025] integrating ChatGPT, an Artificial Intelligence-powered language model
[Tang2024] Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in secondary education
[Zhao2025] generative AI (GAI)

themes.name: Personalized and Adaptive Learning Support
themes.definition: AI systems providing tailored feedback, materials, or interventions to meet individual learner needs, enhancing learning efficiency and outcomes through customization.
evidence: [Huang2023] personalized intervention tutoring approach
[Wang2025a] targeted, real-time feedback
[Li2025a] personalized advisor

themes.name: Collaborative Learning with AI Agents
themes.definition: Students engaging in cooperative tasks with AI tools, such as argumentation or problem-solving, to enhance learning through dialogue and interaction, often in structured pedagogical settings.

themes.name: Ethical and Practical Challenges in AI Implementation
themes.definition: Concerns and obstacles related to the use of AI in education, including ethical issues, technical barriers, and potential negative impacts like over-reliance, as identified in various studies.

themes.name: Innovative Pedagogical Models with AI
themes.definition: Development and application of new teaching methods or frameworks that integrate AI to transform educational practices, often involving dialogic, experiential, or structured approaches.

themes.name: Metacognitive and Reflective Skill Development
themes.definition: Use of AI tools to support students' metacognitive processes, such as reflective writing and self-regulated learning, to enhance deeper understanding and epistemic skills.
evidence: [Neshaei2025] Metacognition meets AI: Empowering reflective writing

[Chang2025] generative AI-assisted reflective writing

data.meta_observations: The abstracts predominantly use quasi-experimental or mixed-methods designs, with a strong focus on specific educational domains like EFL, STEM, nursing, and programming. Critical thinking is a frequently measured outcome, and generative AI integration is a common thread across all studies. Methodological issues such as missing quantitative data are noted in quality notes but do not affect thematic extraction from explicit text.
data.grounding_notes: Some themes are based on limited explicit evidence due to abstract brevity or quality notes indicating missing elements. For instance, personalized learning is explicitly mentioned in only a few abstracts, though implied in others. All evidence quotes are verbatim from the abstracts, and article keys are strictly from the provided closed set.
